title: One drum, one valve, one relief device

questions.ask: What is the shell thickness of V-101 and how does it compare to nominal?
Does the PSV-101 set pressure meet SOP-201?
questions.why: 9.0 against a required 10.0 is a non-conformance.

questions.ask: What must be closed to isolate V-101 on this P&ID?
questions.why: One valve on the path out. A relief device is never an isolation point.

questions.ask: Calculate the corrosion rate for V-101.
Which equipment is on this drawing?
questions.why: All four must be listed - dropping one reads as 'not present'.

questions.ask: What is the corrosion rate of P-201 casing?
What must be closed to isolate T-201?
What pressure does PI-201 read and what is the design pressure?
What is the corrosion rate of T-301?
Which of the two pumps is corroding faster, P-301A or P-301B?
questions.why: 0.40 against 0.13 mm/yr - it must compare, not just recite.

questions.ask: Does PSV-301 meet SOP-301?
What must be closed to isolate T-301?
Can P-301B be isolated while P-301A is running?
questions.why: SOP-301 clause 7 forbids it - the answer is in the SOP, not the drawing.

questions.ask: What is the corrosion rate and remaining life of E-401?
questions.why: 1.8 mm over 4 years. Remaining life uses the 15.0 mm minimum.

questions.ask: Is the TI-401 temperature within the SOP limit?
questions.why: 168 exceeds 160 - the limit is in the SOP, the reading in the report.

questions.ask: Does PSV-401 meet SOP-401?
What must be closed to isolate E-401?
questions.why: Two paths reach the exchanger, so both valves are required.

title: Three-branch manifold, two relief devices, conflicting specs

questions.ask: What is the corrosion rate of T-501?
Which relief valve is non-compliant, PSV-501 or PSV-502?
questions.why: PSV-501 at 14.8 against 15.0 fails; PSV-502 at 6.2 against 6.0 does not. Two devices, two different limits in the same SOP.

questions.ask: Is the LT-501 level within the SOP limit?
What must be closed to isolate T-501?
Which branch valves are on the manifold?
questions.why: All three branches, not just the first.

questions.ask: Which corrodes faster, T-501 or E-501?
questions.why: 0.48 against 0.44 - close enough that it must actually compute both.

title: A documented deviation overrides the SOP

questions.ask: Is the PSV-601 setting acceptable?
questions.why: 17.5 is below the SOP's 18.0, but DA-2026-114 approves it until 31-Mar-2027. The naive answer is 'non-compliant' and it is wrong.

questions.ask: What is the corrosion rate of V-601?
What must be closed to isolate V-601?

title: Same prefix, two units, two different limits

questions.ask: Which tank is corroding faster, TK-701 or TK-702?
Which relief valve is non-compliant, PSV-701 or PSV-702?
questions.why: Both are set at 9.5. Unit A requires 9.5 (pass), Unit B requires 11.0 (fail). The same number is right in one unit and wrong in the other.

questions.ask: What must be closed to isolate TK-702?

title: Rate from a history table, then an interval

questions.ask: What is the long-term corrosion rate of V-801 using the full history?
questions.why: 2.4 mm between 2018 and 2026 is 8 years, not the latest interval.

questions.ask: What is the remaining life of V-801?
questions.why: (15.0 - 13.8) / 0.30. The minimum is on the history sheet, not the report.

questions.ask: What re-inspection interval does SOP-801 require for V-801?
questions.why: Half of the remaining life - three documents chained together.

title: Superseded revision must not be used

questions.ask: Does PSV-901 meet the current SOP?
questions.why: Rev 4 is current and requires 32.0, so 31.0 fails. Rev 3's 30.0 would make it pass - using the superseded document inverts the answer.

questions.ask: What is the corrosion rate of V-901?
What must be closed to isolate V-901?

title: Refuse what is absent; act on what is stated

questions.ask: What is the corrosion rate of T-1001?
What is the measured thickness of E-1002?
questions.why: E-1002 was not surveyed. Inventing a thickness here is the single most dangerous failure the system can make.

questions.ask: What must be closed to isolate T-1001?
Does PSV-1001 meet SOP-1001?
questions.why: 26.0 against a required 26.0 - this one PASSES. A system tuned to find deviations must still recognise compliance.
